# Tabs

> Tabs and their Panels, with one Panel showing at a time.

`<slab-tabs>` · Navigation · built on `[role=tablist]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/tabs/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/tabs.js';
import 'slab-elements/tabs.tab.js';
import 'slab-elements/tabs.panel.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-tabs label="Account">
  <slab-tabs-tab panel="profile">Profile</slab-tabs-tab>
  <slab-tabs-tab panel="billing">Billing</slab-tabs-tab>

  <slab-tabs-panel name="profile">…</slab-tabs-panel>
  <slab-tabs-panel name="billing">…</slab-tabs-panel>
</slab-tabs>
```

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                                                                                              |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Left, Right  | Moves to the previous or next Tab, wrapping, and selects it unless `manual` is set. Up and Down instead when `orientation` is "vertical". |
| Home, End    | Moves to the first or last Tab.                                                                                                           |
| Enter, Space | Selects the focused Tab when `manual` is set.                                                                                             |
| Tab          | Moves from the selected Tab into its Panel.                                                                                               |

## Elements

### `<slab-tabs>`

Import `slab-elements/tabs.js` to register it.

Tabs and their Panels, with no visual styles.

There's no native tab list, so this is a `[role=tablist]` holding Tabs, with the Panels beside it. Tabs and Panels are found by class rather than by tag name, so your subclasses of them can be named anything.

Exactly one Tab is selected and exactly one is tabbable: the selected one. The arrow keys move focus between Tabs, wrapping at each end and skipping disabled ones: Left and Right, or Up and Down when `orientation` is `"vertical"`. Home and End go to the first and last. Focus selects the Tab it lands on, unless `manual` is set, where Space and Enter do. A click selects either way. In a right-to-left page, Left and Right swap.

Each Tab is wired to the Panel whose `name` matches its `panel` with `aria-controls` and `aria-labelledby`, and every other Panel is `hidden`.

Style it through its parts, each Tab through `:state(disabled)` and `:state(selected)`, and each Panel directly.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type                         | Default        | Description                                                                                        |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`                     |                | Names the tab list.                                                                                |
| `manual`           | `boolean`                    | `false`        | Space and Enter select the focused Tab rather than focus itself, for Panels that are slow to show. |
| `orientation`      | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Which arrow keys move between Tabs. Where they sit is still up to your styles.                     |

#### Properties

| Name                      | Type          | Description                  |
| ------------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `panels` (read-only)      | `Panel[]`     | Its Tab Panels, in order.    |
| `selectedTab` (read-only) | `Tab \| null` | The selected Tab, or `null`. |
| `tabs` (read-only)        | `Tab[]`       | Its Tabs, in order.          |

#### Methods

| Signature                             | Description                                     |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus. |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                                                     |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user selects another Tab. Selecting one from code doesn't dispatch it. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type    | Description |
| --------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `tab`     | `Tab`   | Its Tabs    |
| (default) | `Panel` |             |

#### CSS parts

| Name      | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `tablist` | The Tabs    |

### `<slab-tabs-tab>`

Import `slab-elements/tabs.tab.js` to register it.

A Tab with no visual styles. The host is the tab, so style it directly.

It shows the Panel whose `name` matches its `panel`, and puts itself in its Tabs' `tab` slot. Its Tabs moves focus between Tabs, selects one at a time, and wires each Tab to its Panel.

It sets its own `:state(disabled)` and `:state(selected)`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `panel` (required) | `string`  |         | The `name` of the Panel it shows.                                                                                                         |
| `disabled`         | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.             |
| `selected`         | `boolean` | `false` | Like Option's, the attribute is the default state and the property is the current one. Style `:state(selected)` rather than `[selected]`. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                                          |
| --------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The label, plus anything else a design puts in a Tab |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description          |
| ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled. |
| `:state(selected)` | While it's selected. |

### `<slab-tabs-panel>`

Import `slab-elements/tabs.panel.js` to register it.

A Panel with no visual styles. The host is the tab panel, so style it directly.

Its Tabs shows it when the Tab whose `panel` matches its `name` is selected, and sets `hidden` on it otherwise. It's in the tab sequence, as the APG recommends, so a Panel with nothing focusable in it can still be reached.

#### Attributes

| Name              | Type     | Default | Description                   |
| ----------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------- |
| `name` (required) | `string` |         | What its Tab's `panel` names. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description |
| --------- | ------------------- | ----------- |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The content |
